name: causal-ineq
description: Roadmap #9: the causal inequality, executed — the machine-verified theorem layer of the Oreshkov-Costa-Brukner process matrix framework. What exists in the literature: the framework and the causal game (OCB12), SDP-based causal witnesses (ARA15), photonic causal-nonseparability experiments. What did NOT exist: exhaustive machine verification of the causal bound (all deterministic classical causal strategies swept, cap 3/4 exact), the process Born rule executed on exact complex algebra, the process validity constraints as executable certificates (the allowed-pattern rule derived from TPCP invariance, PSD and normalization checked), and the violation cos^2(pi/8) anchored on a machine-constructed valid process matrix with noise threshold 1/sqrt(2) — claims without certificates do not ship
